messages:
Alex: FYI — Bluepine is asking to POC a custom model 'bluepine-13b-v2' next week. Requirements: sub-100ms p95 for single-user chat, KMS-backed keying, and we need to field a security questionnaire. They also want options for 4-bit quantized variants. Who can triage model compatibility and give a pricing ballpark?
Priya: I can take point on compatibility. Do we have the model artifact (hf tar/ggml) and a small sample payload? If it's a LoRA or adapter variant we need to know merge order.
Alex: They sent a link to an S3 bundle (presigned). No LoRA; full weights. Link: https://s3.bluepine-demo/bluepine-13b-v2.tar.gz
Marco: Quick heads-up — our runtime supports quantized paths (q4_0/q4_k_mlp) but we've seen issues with models using GroupNorm + scaled-rope variants. Need the config.json from the bundle to confirm. Also KV cache footprint estimates matter for p95.
Jasmine: I'm putting the onboarding checklist here so we don't miss steps:
```
- verify model config (attn type, norm)
- run compatibility shim (tools/model-checker --input model)
- build q4 candidate + smoke tests
- security questionnaire answers
- POC pricing estimate (hosted vs dedicated)
- schedule customer POC call
```
Priya: Dumped a quick local check: model config shows rmsnorm and rope_type: scaled (not classic). That triggers the 'rope' compatibility codepath; Marco will need to confirm kernel coverage.
Marco: Confirmed. scaled-rope is supported but for q4_k_mlp we need to regenerate the kernel with the rope multiplier patch. I can run the model-checker but will need the model config and the first 3 example prompts. ETA ~4h.
Elena: For the security questionnaire: need data residency, KMS type (they asked HSM), and whether embeddings are logged. Legal turnaround is ~48hr once we have answers.
Alex: On pricing — Bluepine is price-sensitive. For a 2-week POC with ~30 concurrent clients, would you recommend Hosted API with rate-limit uplift or a small Dedicated pool?
Priya: Hosted POC is fastest: estimate ~$3.5k for the POC (token-heavy chat) including priority support. Dedicated (reserved) short-term is more expensive upfront but gives predictable latency; rough estimate ~$15k/mo minimum for a small GPU slice. I'll follow up with exact numbers.
Marco: For latency planning, rough KV cache calc: tokens_per_session=512, avg_batch=6, kv_entry=16 bytes per token (key+value compressed) => 512*6*16=49,152 bytes per session. Multiply by concurrency to size memory. For 30 clients that's ~1.5MB — tiny, but peak concurrency and longer contexts matter. Also quantized model memory differs: q4 candidate reduces model mem ~40%.
Jasmine: Can we offer an A/B fallback during POC? e.g., primary quantized variant then fallback to fp16 hosted model if perf/regression shows issues.
Marco: Yes — runtime supports policy-based fallback. We'll add canary rollout with auto-fallback to fp16 if latency spikes or coherence drops.
Alex: Bluepine also asked about SOC/ISO docs before sharing PII sample prompts. Can we surface relevant certs?
Elena: We can send ISO27001 + SOC2 Type II summary. For anything customer-specific we need an NDA; they've agreed to our standard mutual NDA but legal wants the questionnaire answered first.
security-bot: quick-scan report: no public exposure detected for provided presigned link, bundle hash matches expected pattern but signature not verified. Recommend: verify S3 signature, rotate presigned link after download.
Priya: Action items: (1) Marco run model-checker + q4 build (ETA 4h), (2) Jasmine prepare POC plan & fallback strategy, (3) Elena draft security questionnaire answers (48h), (4) Alex lock POC dates with customer for next Tue/Wed.
Alex: I'll schedule the call and ping Bluepine for the sample prompts and to confirm HSM requirement. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Marco: I'll post the model-checker output here when done. :eyes:
Jasmine: Adding notes to the catalog onboarding issue #4721.
Elena: I'll start the questionnaire draft and loop in compliance.
Priya: If kernel regen is needed, call me and I'll queue a small dedicated slot to build/test.
Alex: Great — moving to calendar invite now.
Marco: model-checker results: minor rope multiplier patch applied, q4_k candidate built, smoke tests passed for 20/24 unit prompts, failing two involving very long context. Investigating.
Priya: Can you attach the failing prompt examples?
Marco: Attached in the bundle (s3://bluepine/results/fail-cases.log). Failing cases are long-context concat > 4096, fallback to fp16 should handle them.
Alex: Looping customer in on Friday to show initial smoke numbers and discuss pricing. :calendar:
